_provenance.description: Public parameter names and tensor shapes for the full-model Model-J StatNN baseline; no weights, examples, class-name maps, labels, or local paths are included.
_provenance.parameter_selection: Sorted torch.nn.Module.named_parameters() names for each Model-J fine-tuned target. ResNet uses Transformers ResNetForImageClassification; SupViT, MAE and DINO use Transformers ViTForImageClassification. All target classifier weights and biases are included; nonparameter buffers are excluded.
_provenance.adaptation: The statistic function is used per named parameter tensor and concatenated. The Model-J task uses a 100-output XGBoost multilabel classifier; it is not the source notebook's LightGBM accuracy-regression task.
